# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 (first iteration)
- Strategy tried: diagnose ALL 7 failing traces by extracting gold-action vs actual-call diffs and the env error on each write. Found one SYSTEMIC root cause (schema drift: `date_of_birth`/`{type,id}` key names rejected by pydantic) underlying most "expected call never made" failures — the agent WAS calling the write tools, but every call bounced on a validation error, so the scorer saw no matching action. Fixed with in-body normalization across 4 write tools + a payment auto-balance + a baggage recompute. (LEDGER row pending this candidate's RESULT.)
- Key process lesson: the summary "expected call was never made" was MISLEADING — the calls WERE made but rejected by schema validation. Always read the actual tool RESULTS (env error strings), not just the gold-vs-actual action list, before concluding a cluster is an action-stall vs a schema/arg defect.
- Plateau/stall signal: none yet (iteration 1).
- What to try next iteration: if A accepted, add a bounded cancellation-eligibility predicate guard (task 19) and a composite rebook flow (task 23); do NOT loosen the global transfer/refuse rule (would regress task 37).
